title: Sequencer saves a live batch alias instead of a snapshot
summary: `indigo_drivers/agent_scripting/library/Sequencer.js:1610-1622` stores `this.saved_batch = property.items`. `boot.js:114-118` updates that exact property.items object in place when the bus delivers changed values. Sequence.focus/focus_ignore_failure at373-384 deliberately expands save_batch→set_batch(1,exposure)→focus→restore_batch. The set_batch acknowledgement overwrites the aliased COUNT/EXPOSURE; restore_batch therefore sends the focus batch values instead of restoring the original capture batch. Source proof follows actual cache mutation and the public focus wrapper; no live agent was changed. Remedy: copy the relevant primitive batch it Full source contracts: helper-manual-review.md H-02. Remedy: copy the relevant primitive batch item values into an independent object and clear/replace snapshots appropriately; test an original batch of several frames with a different exposure, focus success and ignore-failure, then assert restored original values. This is ordinary functional state restoration, not a security assessment of scripting.
evidence: helper-manual-review.md H-02; exact current source paths and firmware/script contracts retained there.
